g.text: Converge — domain model overview (bounded contexts and Published Language)
filled-diamond line: composition inside an aggregate (owned lifecycle)
solid arrow: association to an enumeration-typed attribute
- - > «publishes»: the aggregate records the event; it is sent
to Kafka after the transaction commits
- - > «reacts to»: a consumer in that context turns the event
into a change to this class
- - > labelled "by id only": a reference across aggregates
Attendee assistance has no events: it reads other contexts
over REST. Operational insight only reacts, and its two
alerts stay inside analytics-service. Nothing crosses a
context boundary except the Published Language records.
